I can get DVDs at the library anytime I want! How did anyone ever convince me paid subscriptions WITH ADs were okay?!
item.content:encoded:
For $15, I got a used DVD player. It was so liberating to watch a movie with no interruptions. No ads! Nobody trying to sell me dubious meds with more side effects than benefits.

I can get DVDs at the library anytime I want! How did anyone ever convince me paid subscriptions WITH ADs were okay?!
